column2: [intro]
Convertible, you were my pride,
We drove with ease.
The wind in my hair, the sun on my skin,
My little car, so perfect for me.
My little red car, so pretty,
We sped along the roads without worry.
From Neuchâtel to Colombier, how beautiful it was,
In my little electric car from the 90s.
Every turn, every unique moment,
Engraved in my heart, a source of music.
But the time has come to say goodbye,
To my little car, you who made me happy.
My little red car, so pretty,
We sped along the roads without worry.
From Neuchâtel to Colombier, how beautiful it was,
In my little electric car from the 90s.
[ solo ]
My little red car, I will leave you,
Time has passed, it must be accepted.
The memories will remain forever,
In my little car, engraved forever.
[outro]
